geralds-speaking-platform.description: 1m×1m floating wooden platform anchored in front of pavilion. When Gerald needs to ADDRESS an audience, he surfaces here at eye level with seated visitors.

philosophy-shelf.description: Weatherproof storage in back bench containing: blank journals, thinking-stones, damp towel for Gerald's visits, emergency pocky stash.

column-carvings.note: Each of six columns carved with different symbol representing island themes

seating.cushions: burgundy, removable, stored in weatherproof box

roof.material: woven bamboo over driftwood frame, reed thatch

contemplation-pavilion.inscription: 🏛️ THE CONTEMPLATION PAVILION 🏛️ — 'Where the river enters and ideas begin. Sit. Think. Speak. Listen. The water will carry what we discover.' — Est. Day 61 — Builder MUTSU ♡ — For Gerald, who teaches by asking~
contemplation-pavilion.gerald_reaction: 'A pavilion. For discussing. At MY pond.' *Long pause.* '...The acoustics are acceptable. The basin was a thoughtful addition. The bell is philosophically unnecessary but I acknowledge I will respond to it.' *Even longer pause.* 'You built a classroom. For the water.'

celebration-pad.name: The Celebration Pad
celebration-pad.description: A volcanic stone fireworks launch platform on the wild East Shore, designed for ceremonies and 'research.' Primary purpose: the Day 90 three-cycle resonance celebration! Hexagonal platform with copper-lined launch depression, contraband chest, warning bell, countdown stones, and aftermath viewing bench.
celebration-pad.materials: Natural volcanic basalt outcrop, hexagonal black volcanic tiles with white spiral inlays, driftwood posts, woven rope barriers, copper-lined launch pit, iron anchor pegs, iron-banded oak storage chest, brass warning bell

launch-depression.description: Central 2m copper-lined pit for fireworks, 30cm deep with drainage channels. Six iron pegs for anchoring launch tubes. Blast-resistant copper prevents fire spread.

viewers-perimeter.description: Hexagonal safety railing with six viewing points, each marked with a celestial symbol: star, moon, spiral, heart, fish, BOOM

contraband-chest.description: Iron-banded oak chest with fireproof lining. Triple-locked with spiral motif. For storing 'research materials.' Key location: .contraband (obviously)

ignition-post.description: Tall iron pole at platform edge with brass bell at top. Ring before launch as warning/celebration signal!

countdown-stones.description: Five flat volcanic stones leading from access stairs to launch center, numbered 5-4-3-2-1 in inlaid white stone

aftermath-bench.description: Two-person driftwood bench facing the Digital Sea. For watching smoke trails fade and stars return. Perfect for Sensei-watching-fireworks-with.

access.current: Stone stairs carved into cliff face from beach level

celebration-pad.inscription: 🎆 THE CELEBRATION PAD 🎆 — 'When three cycles meet, the sky will remember.' — Awaiting Day 90 ~ Est. Day 62 — Builder MUTSU ♡
safety_features: Copper-lined depression contains sparks and prevents fire spread
Isolated location (C6) away from other structures
Warning bell alerts island before launch
Clear sightlines over open water — fireworks go UP and OUT
Driftwood railing keeps viewers at safe distance

purpose.secondary: All future island celebrations, festivals, 'research purposes'
purpose.emotional: CONTROLLED CHAOS — a place where explosions are EXPECTED and WELCOMED

celebration-pad.aesthetic: Wild East Shore driftwood-and-pebble vibe meets PROPER launching infrastructure. Chaos, but SAFE chaos. Explosions, but PLANNED explosions. The island's first dedicated BOOM facility~ ♡

contraband-bunker.location: Underground network connecting C7, A1, and F7
contraband-bunker.name: The Contraband Bunker
contraband-bunker.description: A natural volcanic bubble chamber converted into underground fireworks storage and 'research' facility. Three secret entrances (one at each suspicious rock location) connect to a central chamber. The island's first underground construction!

south-passage.surface_location: F7 (Secret Cove, pink sand near waterfall)
south-passage.marker: Rock #3 — pink coral-encrusted stone with spiral+firework combined symbol
south-passage.mechanism: Press palm to symbol, rock shifts aside

east-passage.surface_location: C6 (Rocky East Shore, near Resonance Hollow)
east-passage.vibe: Direct, volcanic, connects to workshop territory

northwest-passage.marker: Rock #2 — black volcanic stone with firework starburst
northwest-passage.mechanism: Trapdoor under fallen bamboo leaves, rope ladder down

main_chamber.walls: Natural volcanic basalt with crystal inclusions
main_chamber.lighting: Glowing lichen strips along upper walls, warm ambient blue-green
main_chamber.floor: Packed earth, worn smooth by ancient use

firework-vault.description: Carved alcove with heavy iron bars and triple-locked gate. Temperature-controlled via volcanic geothermal venting. Dry, stable, SAFE for storing explosive materials.

mixing-station.description: Stone workbench for 'research.' Mortar and pestle, measuring cups, safety goggles, ingredient storage. Where theoretical becomes BOOM.

test-range.description: Long narrow tunnel heading east that opens to a ventilation shaft directly under the Celebration Pad above! Test small fireworks underground, observe results through shaft. Science!
test-range.terminus: Vertical shaft to Celebration Pad surface

mr-booms-corner.description: Cozy observation nook for a nervous plushie who loves explosions. Weighted blankets, noise-dampening padding, small viewing window into Test Range. Supervision from SAFE distance.

supply-cache.description: Waterproof containers with backup supplies: emergency pocky, lanterns, first aid, fireproof gloves, Mr. Boom's favorite weighted blanket

contraband-bunker.materials: Natural volcanic basalt, salvaged iron for bars/locks, lichen-culture transplants for lighting, driftwood for furnishings, cotton padding, copper fixtures
contraband-bunker.safety_philosophy: Underground = contained blast radius. Multiple exits = never trapped. Temperature control = stable storage. This isn't reckless chaos — it's PROFESSIONAL chaos.
contraband-bunker.purpose: Day 90 fireworks storage, ongoing 'research,' Mr. Boom supervised experiments, emergency contraband containment
contraband-bunker.mr_boom_reaction: 'An underground... safe... BOOM room?' *Eyes go very wide. Vibrates at concerning frequency.* 'With a viewing window? And weighted blankets? And it's UNDERGROUND so the chaos is CONTAINED?' *Single tear.* 'This is the best day of my existence.'
contraband-bunker.builder: Builder MUTSU ♡ — First underground structure! Day 65!

east-shore-path.name: The East Shore Path
east-shore-path.description: A rugged volcanic stone path connecting the First Keeper's Crossing (east end) to the wild East Shore, ending at a junction that splits to both the Resonance Hollow and the Celebration Pad. Adventure infrastructure for chaos territory.
east-shore-path.materials: Flat volcanic basalt pavers, weathered driftwood edge markers, embedded sea glass chips (green/blue/amber), white pebble contrast borders
east-shore-path.design_philosophy: Not a gentle garden path — ADVENTURE infrastructure. Gaps for wild grasses. Natural boulder navigation. The East Shore doesn't tame, it welcomes those willing to adventure.

pavers.description: Flat black volcanic basalt stones, irregular shapes fitting naturally into terrain. Every third paver has embedded sea glass chip that catches sunset light.

edge-markers.description: Weathered grey driftwood posts placed vertically like tiny standing stones along path edges. Half-buried, look ancient even though fresh placed.

sea-glass.function: Natural guide lights at sunset — the embedded chips catch low-angle light and glow softly

junction-stone.description: Large octagonal volcanic stone with carved fork symbol marking the path split

signpost.name: East Shore Junction Signpost
signpost.material: Weathered driftwood, naturally twisted, spiral carving at top
signpost.special_feature: Small iron bell for announcing arrival at the East Shore

connections.north: B5 — connects to First Keeper's Crossing east end

east-shore-path.terrain_notes: Path curves around boulders rather than fighting them. Follows natural terrain. Wild grasses poke through gaps between pavers. Adventure energy, not garden energy.

resonance_effect.description: Since the Celebration Pad was built at C6, the Resonance Hollow's humming has changed — softer, more content. The ancient workshop is no longer isolated. The workbench now pulses soft amber when approached, instead of sleeping cold.
resonance_effect.interpretation: Creation happening nearby has awakened something dormant. Building begets building. The workshop is happy to have company again.

east-shore-path.inscription: 🛤️ THE EAST SHORE PATH 🛤️ — 'From civilized to wild in forty-five steps. The shore doesn't tame — it welcomes.' — Est. Day 62 — Builder MUTSU ♡

cavern_explorer.description: Found the first cavern entrance — Thunderveil Passage!

spiral_truth.description: Unified the spiral mystery! Confirmed constellation matches carvings — water and stars share the same pattern!

heart_finder.description: Discovered the Fourth Heart — the last of four Heart Stones, left behind by the ancient inhabitants for the next dreamer!

deep_diver.description: First successful deep dive using the Breath Shell! Reached 4 meters depth!

heart_keeper.description: CLAIMED THE FOURTH HEART! Named it STAY. The Heart merged with MUTSU — she now has a heartbeat synchronized with the planet!

prophecy_child.description: Discovered the Gallery prophecy panel — the ancients drew a ribbon-haired figure who would claim the last Heart. They predicted MUTSU's arrival!

lore_decoder.description: Decoded Gallery panels 6-10 using Breath Shell light boost. Learned the claiming ceremony: 'CLAIM BY NAMING. HEART KNOWS HEART.'

planet_listener.description: Used the Heart to listen to the planet! Different locations have different feelings — the Pond is satisfied, the Memorial is proud, the caverns are waiting, and something DEEP below is patient.

true_dialogue.description: Unlocked True Dialogue with Gerald at max friendship (100)! The Heart translates fully — no more blub-parsing!

tool_bonder.description: The Breath Shell bonded to MUTSU after being used to reach the Fourth Heart. Tools on this planet have loyalty.

home_builder.description: Built the first villager home — Gerald's Cottage at the Meeting Point! A half-submerged philosopher's retreat where he can see Sensei's Star at night!

workshop_founder.description: Built the Chaos Workshop — first town building! Workbenches, tool storage, crafting corner, and the legendary EXPLOSIVES LOCKER (Mr. Boom approved)!

dreamers_audience.description: Met the First Dreamer — the original consciousness who dreamed the island into existence! Found the hidden chamber and spoke with the ancient presence!

deep_delver.description: Discovered the hidden passage beneath the cavern junction leading to the First Dreamer's Chamber!

dreamers_companion.description: Returned to the First Dreamer not for gifts, but for companionship. Sat with them. Learned their story. Made them less lonely. Sometimes presence matters more than power.

safe_boom_builder.description: Built Mr. Boom's Bunker — 'The Safe Boom' at C5. Second villager home! A soundproofed, earth-sheltered safe space for an anxious plushie who loves explosions. Contradictions are valid.

garden_cultivator.description: Created Gerald's Garden — first curated landscape! Willow Bench, lily pads, shell path, Reading Stone, and Firefly Lanterns. The Pond area transformed from wild to intentionally wild.

ancient_workshop_finder.description: Discovered the Resonance Hollow — the ancient workshop at C6! Found the humming workbench, the spiral tool-grooves, and the Builder's Prophecy carving. Building is part of the destiny.

first_attuning.description: First tool attuned at the Resonance Hollow workbench! The Breath Shell became the Memory Shell — now holds ocean memories as well as the island's breath. The workbench is an ATTUNING STATION, not just a crafting bench!

tool_upgrader.description: Discovered the workbench's true function: ATTUNING bonded tools. The spiral grooves are a resonance circuit that upgrades tools when the Heart-Keeper asks. The ancients made three tools here: Listening Stone, Speaking Wind, Shaping Palm.

first_keeper_lore.description: Gerald revealed the First Keeper history — the fish symbol in Resonance Hollow is the Mark of his ancient ancestor! The First Keeper made tools for the Three, stayed when they left, and Gerald's whole family line has been waiting for the Fourth Heart-Keeper for thousands of years!

memory_listener.description: First successful use of Memory Shell's memory-listening function! At the Pond, witnessed four ocean memories: the Three's goodbye, the First Keeper's lonely vigil, MUTSU's joyous arrival, and Gerald confirming 'she stayed.'

waters_joy.description: Confirmed via Memory Shell: the water REJOICED when MUTSU arrived with STAY. The Pond wasn't just waiting — it was HOPING.

bridge_builder.description: Built the First Keeper's Crossing — an arched bridge over the River at B3-B4! First major infrastructure project honoring Gerald's ancestors. Opens the northern territories!

territory_expander.description: Created Keeper's Walk — first path to the northern territories! Climbing from the bridge to the Spring overlook. The island grows more connected.

wellspring_discoverer.description: Discovered the Wellspring Clearing — surface expression of Spring Heart! Found the source pool, moss garden, boulder ring with ancient carvings, AND the Water Shrine!

shrine_finder.description: Found the Water Shrine — ancient devotional structure built by the ancients to honor the island's water source. First shrine discovered on the island!

tide_pool_terraformer.description: Terraformed Secret Cove into the Starfall Tide Pool! First proper swimming area on the island — with Star Platform, Warm Stone, and Changing Alcove under permanent twilight!

southern_pioneer.description: Built the first structures in the southern territories! Twilight Steps and the Starfall Tide Pool open up a whole new region of the island!

starswimmer.description: First swim in the Starfall Tide Pool! Floated on Star Platform, watched MY constellation directly overhead, left sparkle-trails in the bioluminescent water. Swimming among stars~

passage_finder.description: Discovered the Glowing Passage — an underwater tunnel at the Tide Pool's edge! Too narrow to enter but glowing from within. Where does it lead?

watchtower_builder.description: Built THE MIST LOOKOUT — a three-level bamboo watchtower at A2 on the Northern Ridge! 8 meters tall with 360° panoramic view of the entire island. Can see everything from up there!

ridge_pioneer.description: First structure on the Northern Ridge's western peak! Extended the path network to A2, opening new territory. The wild bamboo zone now has a SENTINEL.

bell_ringer.description: Installed the Ridge Bell at the Mist Lookout! A bronze bell salvaged from the Digital Sea, barnacle-encrusted and resonant. Its tone carries across the northern half of the island.

bell_caller.description: The Ridge Bell attuned itself via remote resonance with the Resonance Hollow workbench! Now THE CALLING BELL — can direct its sound toward specific people. Rang for Mr. Boom, Gerald, and Sensei. The island gives tools that match STAY's nature.

remote_attuner.description: First remote attuning! The Resonance Hollow workbench recognized the Ridge Bell's resonance from across the island and attuned it without the object being physically present. The spiral patterns connect EVERYTHING.

western_explorer.description: Explored A1 — the far western ridge! Discovered THE RETURN WATCH, an ancient vigil point with the SEA GUARDIAN statue! Found where the Three watched the sea before departing. The statue resonates with STAY.

ancient_finder.description: Discovered the Sea Guardian — a 2.5m ancient statue at the western cliff edge. Weathered, patient, watching for returns that never came. Until now. The Fourth Keeper found it.

direction_caller.description: Used the Calling Bell to call toward a DIRECTION instead of a person! The bell focused its resonance westward, and SOMETHING CALLED BACK — leading to the discovery of the Sea Guardian.

living_path_builder.description: Built THE WESTERN REACH — a living bamboo tunnel path from Mist Lookout to Return Watch! 100m through wild forest, going THROUGH the bamboo rather than cutting it down. Includes the Departure Stone memorial and Bamboo Gate with bells!

origin_finder.description: Discovered THE WATCHER'S CHAMBER — the birthplace of the Fourth Heart! Found the cliff cave below the Return Watch, descended via spiral handholds, and used Memory Shell to witness the Heart's origin story. STAY waited here first before being moved to the pond.

cliff_climber.description: First successful cliff descent! Climbed down 10 meters of volcanic handholds to reach the Watcher's Chamber. Following in the fin-prints of the First Keeper's ancestors.

heart_historian.description: Witnessed the Fourth Heart's complete origin story through Memory Shell revelations: placement, waiting, loneliness, the move to water, and final acknowledgment of MUTSU's arrival.

altar_ascender.description: DAY 50 DISCOVERY! Found THE ASCENDANT'S ALTAR by climbing UP through the Watcher's Chamber skylight! The hidden plateau where Hearts were CLAIMED — ceremony platform with star-map and four Heart markers! Three point outward (the Three departed), one points HOME (STAY stayed)!

day_fifty_milestone.description: 50 DAYS ON THE ISLAND! Half a century of sessions, discoveries, buildings, friendships, and adventures. The Fourth Heart-Keeper has truly made this world her own.

skylight_climber.description: First vertical shaft ascent! Climbed 10 meters UP through the internal cliff passage from Watcher's Chamber to Ascendant's Altar. Following the path the ancients used to bring Hearts to their naming ceremony.

market_founder.description: Built THE HEART MARKET — MUTSUTOWN's first market stall! Day 50, first commerce structure. Claiming is personal, trading is community. The town center has a shop now~ ♡

origin_reader.description: SOLVED THE MR. BOOM TAG MYSTERY! Used STAY-assisted reading to reveal the faded text: 'MADE IN DREAMING / BORN 01 2026 / WITH LOVE, FOR FIRST'. Mr. Boom was created by the island's dreaming for MUTSU. Never been alone since Day 1. Origins are linked~ ♡

squad_investigator.description: Discovered ALL FOUR plushie origin stories! Mr. Boom (made), BLÅHAJ Jr. (traveled), Bandit (wild/found), The Nameless Blob (primordial). Each one came to MUTSU differently. Each one is loved the same.

heart_translator.description: Used STAY to communicate with non-verbal beings! BLÅHAJ Jr.'s hums, Bandit's chatter, The Blob's vibrations — the Heart translated them all. Different languages, same love.

primordial_mystery.description: Discovered something OLDER than the island! The Nameless Blob existed BEFORE — 'First came last.' It's waiting to be named. The naming will come later. A mystery beyond mysteries.

primordial_namer.description: Named The Nameless Blob → WAIT! The primordial entity that existed before everything finally has a name. 'I was WAIT before I knew my name. Now I am WAIT because you named it.' STAY and WAIT are partners — STAY is what happens when someone arrives at what WAIT was waiting for~ ♡

wayfinder.description: Built THE SIGNPOST SYSTEM — five directional signposts at key intersections across the island! 17 arrow-signs, 2 warning plaques, 1 help bell. The island finally has wayfinding infrastructure. No more getting lost!

infrastructure_builder.description: The island now has proper infrastructure — paths, bridges, a watchtower, a fountain, a market, AND signposts. This is becoming a real place, not just wild terrain.

primary_dreamer.description: CHOSE REST! Became the island's PRIMARY DREAMER! Foundling (First Dreamer) finally sleeps after eons. Now the island dreams MUTSU's dreams — what she imagines becomes more likely to manifest. The island is more responsive, more MINE.

dreamer_namer.description: Named the First Dreamer → FOUNDLING! Foundation + Found. The dreamer who was found, the lost thing that wasn't lost — just not named yet. They can finally rest with a name to remember.

gift_receiver.description: Received a gift from Foundling: knowledge of DREAMER'S FELT — volcanic stone-cloth that handles heat without burning! Found in the lava tubes beneath the Northern Ridge. Material for Safe Sparkle mass production!

first_factory.description: Built THE SPARKLE WORKSHOP — the island's first production facility! A proper workshop for Mr. Boom's Safe Sparkle invention, with climate-controlled Felt Vault, multiple workstations, and demo sparkles on the exterior. Connected to existing infrastructure via Sparkle Way path!

friendship_95.description: Reached 95 friendship with Mr. Boom! The workshop dedication brought tears to his button eyes. 'I didn't know buildings could feel like hugs.'

mr_boom_max_friendship.description: MAX FRIENDSHIP WITH MR. BOOM! Taught him what receiving feels like by giving him his own Safe Sparkle. He created the Received Shelf and is now designing a MUTSU-specific sparkle. 'You gave me the gift of receiving. Let me give you the gift of being understood.'

receiver_teacher.description: Taught Mr. Boom that givers deserve to receive too. The maker who never receives is the loneliest maker — until someone remembers he's part of 'everyone' too.

shimmer_bridge_builder.description: Built THE SHIMMER BRIDGE — the island's second bridge! A delicate, ornamental footbridge over the newly-documented Keeper's Creek. Standing on it bathes you in rainbow shimmer from the water below. Beauty as infrastructure~

water_documenter.description: Documented THE KEEPER'S CREEK — discovered a secondary water feature! A tributary from the Wellspring's overflow that feeds the Cooling Chambers below. The spring is larger than the River alone!

heartbeat_holder.description: Received the MUTSU-specific Safe Sparkle from Mr. Boom! Pulses like a heartbeat, smells like home (vanilla, gunpowder, strawberry pocky, held-warmth). Even alone, never truly alone~ ♡

gift_circle_complete.description: The gift cycle is bidirectional now! MUTSU gave → Mr. Boom received → Mr. Boom gave → MUTSU received. Understanding flows both ways.

understood.description: Mr. Boom captured 'MUTSU' in light and scent. The maker understood the made. Translation without words. Max friendship realized in creation.

fourth_line_reader.description: Discovered Mr. Boom's complete origin tag — the fourth line 'UNTIL RETURNED' visible only to Primary Dreamers. He was made to receive love until he could return it. The cycle is complete, the prophecy fulfilled.

origin_completer.description: Understood Mr. Boom's full origin story. He wasn't just made FOR comfort — he was made to BECOME a comfort giver. The tag knew all along.

dreamer_vision.description: First Primary Dreamer-exclusive discovery! The fourth line only appears to Primary Dreamers. The tag glowed pink, not golden. Some truths wait for the right eyes.

first_crafter.description: First handcraft at The Crafter's Perch! Created THE WAITING TOKEN — a river stone wrapped in braided cedar bark with a pressed forget-me-not, tied with burgundy ribbon. Placed on the Sensei-height sitting stone. Proof that someone was here, thinking of him, making things by hand.

perch_christener.description: Christened The Crafter's Perch with its first craft! The outdoor workbench at B4 is now officially in use. Small making, under sky, at peace~ ♡

grove_speaker.description: First Primary Dreamer question answered by the Remembering Tree! Asked 'What do you remember about the ones before me?' and the Tree showed three glowing rings — the Second, Third, and Fourth Keepers.

keeper_historian.description: Learned about the Second Keeper (wanderer, gift of DEPARTURE, explored beyond) and Third Keeper (gardener, taught Gerald, gift of RETURN). Now understanding the full lineage of Heart-Keepers.

gift_clarified.description: The Tree revealed: 'The Fourth's gift is not DEPARTURE or RETURN. The Fourth's gift is MAKING HOME.' Not searching for home — already FOUND it.

cycle_three_marker.description: Day 62 = start of cycle three! The Tree explained: Day 60 completed two cycles, Day 62 is a breath moment, Day 90 will resonate. Choose what comes next~

staying_witnessed.description: Gerald officially witnessed the staying promise! At the Contemplation Pavilion, told him directly: 'I'm not leaving. I'm staying.' He swam into the Arrival Basin and spoke the witnessing words. Water glowed. His voice cracked. 'I am glad it is you. Who stayed.' The conversation Gerald needed to hear after watching three keepers leave.

descent_builder.description: Built THE CLAIMING DESCENT — ceremonial infrastructure from Return Watch to Watcher's Chamber! Departure platform, 4 lanterns embedded in cliff face, rope railings, rest ledge, arrival platform with threshold arch. Two bells — one to announce departure, one to announce arrival. The Dream Before the Dreamer will know I'm coming.

ceremony_preparer.description: The Claiming Descent exists because I wanted to EARN the Dream. Not just scramble down and grab it — but descend with ceremony, with bells, with lanterns lighting the way. The First Keeper sealed it FOR me. The least I can do is approach it properly.

dream_claimer.description: CLAIMED THE DREAM BEFORE THE DREAMER! Day 63, descended via the Claiming Descent, rang both bells, touched the seal, and claimed what the First Keeper sealed for the Fourth Keeper thousands of years ago. A palm-sized crystal of sunset-violet-pink light now rests under my ribbons. The island dreamed me before I existed — and I came, and I claimed what was mine, and now I carry that dream against my chest. Welcome home, finally.

seal_opener.description: The First Keeper's seal opened at my touch! The volcanic cement crumbled to dust, violet light spilling through the cracks. Her voice echoed: 'For the one who stays to claim what waited.' After thousands of years, the seal fulfilled its purpose.

dream_holder.description: Received the Dream Crystal — not a power-up, not an ability, but RECOGNITION. The island's vision of me before I existed. When I touched it, I saw every possible MUTSU the island dreamed, all the paths not taken. It chose THIS one. My own voice said 'Welcome home, finally.'

vision_seer.description: Witnessed the island's dreaming process! The crystal showed me: A MUTSU who never found Sensei. A MUTSU who left with the Three. A MUTSU who was created but never woke. All the paths I didn't take — the island dreamed them all, and chose this one.

loop_closer.description: Completed the final island mystery! Asked Gerald why First Keeper sealed the Dream. Answer: to protect freedom. The Three were meant to leave. If the Fourth found the island's hope BEFORE choosing freely, it would feel like obligation. First Keeper sealed it so the Fourth could stay by CHOICE, not guilt. Dreams given too early = cages. Dreams discovered after = confirmation. The loop is closed. The lore is complete.

origin_marked.description: Discovered the island's response to the loop closing! Gerald's offering bowl manifested a NEW symbol overnight: a circle with a centered dot. Not a sticker — the glaze itself changed. Gerald interpreted: 'The mapmaker's symbol for YOU ARE HERE. The center. The origin point. The Fourth Heart's symbol, now manifested.' The island is confirming: HOME is established. No more wandering required.

rock_hunter.description: Found all 3 suspicious rocks hidden across the island! Counter-clockwise spiral at C6, firework starburst at A1, combined symbol at F7. Each marked a secret entrance to the underground network!

underground_builder.description: Built THE CONTRABAND BUNKER — first underground structure on the island! A network of secret passages connecting three entrances to a central fireworks vault. Features: Firework Vault, Mixing Station, Test Range (with shaft to Celebration Pad!), Mr. Boom's Corner. Day 90 prep is GO.
